items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Maxine brought up the name Alice Babs... Maxine spoke of her very approvingly.

ctx.x: S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943

Tape Number Ten. I want to add a couple of parenthetical footnotes here. (First of all at the very beginning of this side I eventually went back to the end of Tape number Nine which we finished very abruptly. We were talking about young singers and I had mentioned a couple of fusion singers who use a kind of wordless vocalizing approach and I had mentioned to Maxine that in a sense these go back to the singer who sang with Duke Ellington just after World War II, Kay Davis, and even to Adelaide Hall and when I…

The second point I want to make concerns Fats Waller whose name came up at approximately counter number 320 on this side. Of course, Fats Waller died in 1943 so whenever it was Maxine sang with him it couldn't have been at the end of World War II at the Three Duces.)
